'''R2-T4''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served onboard [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
